text:
maria-ops: Heads-up — weird scale-to-zero hit in eu-west this morning. Two GPU nodepools drained even though I thought they had an idle label set. Anyone else seeing label sensitivity?
kevin-sre: can you paste the node labels + autoscaler logs?
maria-ops: quick dump: `kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-eu-west -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,LABELS:.metadata.labels` shows `idle_epoch=20260308` on the nodes but CA log shows it checking for `idle-epoch`.
ben-infra: oh that's a classic — our node bootstrap template sets `idle_epoch` (underscore) but autoscaler checks `idle-epoch` (dash). came up during the nodepool rename last month. :face_with_monocle:
julia-eng: ugh. So autoscaler thinks nodes are untagged and evicts them as idle? any evidence in the CA event stream?
kevin-sre: pasted a tail from CA controller logs: `I0314 07:11:23.123456 1 node_group.go:312] >> Node gpu-eu-west-1a: labels missing: idle-epoch` then it schedules scale-down.
maria-ops: timeline: 07:08 traffic dip -> warm pool entered cooldown -> 07:10 CA evaluated nodes -> 07:11 drained two nodes. Warm-pool cooldown is 300s in the helm chart.
ben-infra: quick mitigation: we can patch nodes to include the dashed label. `kubectl label nodes -l nodepool=gpu-eu-west idle-epoch=20260308 --overwrite` should stop immediate evictions.
julia-eng: +1. but long-term we should make labels idempotent. propose we accept both keys in the CA readiness check or normalize at bootstrap.
kevin-sre: agree. two action items: 1) hotfix patch nodes now, 2) update cluster-autoscaler config to check both keys. we can add a node-condition alias via a small wrapper script in the nodeup systemd unit.
ben-infra: also found the helm values that caused this: in `charts/nodepool/values.yaml` we have `labels: { idle_epoch: "{{ .Epoch }}" }`. should change to `idle-epoch` or template both.
autoscaler-bot: scheduled job: `patch-nodes-add-dash-label` started at 07:36 by ben-infra. (simulated)
maria-ops: hotfix applied, I see patched nodes now show both `idle_epoch` and `idle-epoch`. CA logs stop complaining about missing labels. monitoring alert clearing. :thumbsup:
julia-eng: for the follow-up RFC: suggest adding a migration job that runs during deploys for 2 weeks to ensure both labels exist, and a lint in the helm chart to prevent underscores. also bump warm-pool cooldown to 420s for this pool while we validate.
kevin-sre: note for runbooks: if nodes drain unexpectedly, check for label mismatches first (underscore vs dash), then check warm-pool cooldown + CA probe window. add a one-liner for ops: `kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-eu-west -o=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.metadata.labels}\n{end}'`
ben-infra: created short PR to `charts/nodepool` with template for both labels and unit tests. linking in #infra-prs.
maria-ops: thanks all. leaving the autoscaler patch and helm change to ben/julia. I'll keep monitoring for repeated churn and update on-call if anything else pops.
